About Us Kumaran Systems: Engineering Future-Ready Transformations Since 1992, Kumaran Systems has been helping enterprises bridge the past and the future, reimagining legacy systems and embracing AI-led possibilities. With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. We help organisations not just upgrade their systems but reimagine what’s possible. Why Kumaran? We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. Our global delivery model ensures agility, responsiveness, and seamless collaboration, with clients always at the heart of every engagement. At Kumaran, we don’t just solve problems, we engineer future-ready transformations. Position Summary We are seeking a highly motivated .NET Full Stack Developer with 4–6 years of professional software development experience to design, build, and enhance Azure-hosted applications supporting Global Asset Management solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise across the Microsoft technology stack, modern frontend frameworks, cloud-native development, and DevOps practices. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities Application Development Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using C#, .NET Core/.NET 6+, and Microsoft technologies. Develop scalable and secure RESTful APIs and implement microservice-based solutions where appropriate. Build responsive, user-friendly web applications using Angular or React with TypeScript. Design and optimize relational database schemas, develop SQL queries, stored procedures, and ensure database performance. Develop Azure-hosted solutions leveraging Azure Functions, App Services, and Azure SQL. Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Azure Entra ID. Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews to ensure solution quality and maintainability. Produce clean, reusable, well-documented code that adheres to enterprise development standards and best practices. Cloud & DevOps Build, deploy, and maintain cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure services. Develop and support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Enterprise. Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate application deployments and improve release processes. Monitor application performance and proactively address reliability, scalability, and security concerns. Quality Assurance Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, Jest, or Jasmine. Participate in peer code reviews, static code analysis, and quality assurance activities. Troubleshoot application issues and implement performance improvements and bug fixes. Maintain technical documentation, API specifications, and deployment documentation. Agile Delivery & Collaboration Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA engineers, UX designers, and business stakeholders. Mentor junior developers by providing technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and code review feedback. Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Generative AI Adoption Utilize GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and other approved AI-assisted development tools to improve development productivity. Create structured prompts for code generation, unit testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. Review, validate, and refine AI-generated code to ensure security, maintainability, and compliance with organizational coding standards. Promote responsible adoption of AI-assisted software development practices within the engineering team. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 4–6 years of professional experience in full-stack software development. Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Core/.NET 6+, and modern software development practices. Experience developing secure and scalable RESTful APIs. Hands-on experience with Angular or React using TypeScript. Strong knowledge of Entity Framework Core, SQL, database design, and performance optimization. Experience developing cloud-native applications using Microsoft Azure services. Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), API security, and Azure Entra ID integration. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Enterprise. Experience with unit testing and integration testing frameworks. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies using Jira and Confluence. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Kendo UI for enterprise web application development. Advanced knowledge of Azure Entra ID, including application registrations, RBAC, and enterprise identity management. Experience with document generation technologies such as Open XML (OOXML) and Aspose. Knowledge of PowerShell scripting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or Bicep. Experience working within highly regulated or security-sensitive enterprise environments. Exposure to Global Asset Management, Banking, or Financial Services domains. Technical Skills Backend: C#, .NET Core/.NET 6+, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core Frontend: Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript APIs: RESTful APIs, Microservices Database: SQL Server, Azure SQL, Database Design Cloud: Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Security: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Azure Entra ID DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, CI/CD Testing: xUnit, NUnit, Jest, Jasmine Project Tools: Jira, Confluence AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Version Control: Git Key Competencies Strong software engineering fundamentals Full-stack application development expertise Cloud-native application development Secure coding and API design Agile mindset and collaborative teamwork Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Mentoring and technical leadership capabilities Show more Show less Seniority level Not Applicable Employment type Full-time Industries IT Services and IT Consulting Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Kumaran Systems by 2x See who you know

Direct message the job poster from Zemoso Technologies Supriya Animelli Supriya Animelli Talent Acquisition Member Senior GenAI Engineer ● Overall experience: 5–8 years ● Location: Bangalore (or willing to relocate to Bangalore) Role Overview We are looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer with strong core engineering foundations and hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions. This role is execution- and ownership-focused — responsible for delivering GenAI features end-to-end (backend + frontend), working with agentic AI workflows, and mentoring junior engineers while handling ambiguous requirements. This position is part of our GenAI hiring phase, where we prioritize strong full-stack/backend engineers who have recently built and shipped GenAI and agentic AI solutions in production. Experience Profile ● Overall experience: 5–8 years ● Core engineering background: Python (Django / FastAPI) ● GenAI experience: 2-3+ years of hands-on, production-level experience, including Agentic AI. Key Responsibilities GenAI Solution Development ● Build and deploy GenAI-powered features within real-world products, spanning backend (Python — Django/FastAPI) ● Design and implement RAG pipelines, including: ○ Embeddings ○ Vector databases ○ Retrieval strategies ● Integrate GenAI capabilities with backend systems via APIs and services.● Build responsive, GenAI-integrated UI/UX components in React to surface AI-driven features to end users. System & Solution Ownership ● Own GenAI solutions end-to-end, from design to production rollout — across backend, frontend, and AI layers. ● Design RAG architectures and decide: ○ Chunking strategies ○ Retrieval approaches ● Handle ambiguous requirements and convert them into working, shippable solutions. Reliability, Quality & Performance ● Address latency, cost, and evaluation considerations in GenAI systems. ● Implement guardrails and safety mechanisms. ● Contribute to monitoring and basic operational readiness. Agentic AI (Core Focus) ● Build and own agent-based workflows, including: ○ Multi-step reasoning flows ○ Tool/function calling ○ Orchestrated GenAI interactions ● Work hands-on with agent frameworks to design and deploy production-grade agentic systems (deep research not required, but practical build experience expected). Mentoring & Collaboration ● Mentor junior engineers working on GenAI components. ● Review GenAI-related code and designs, across both backend and frontend implementations. ● Collaborate closely with backend, frontend, data, and product teams. Must-Have Skills ● Strong engineering experience in Python (Django / FastAPI) ● Hands-on experience building GenAI applications in production. ● Experience with: ○ RAG pipelines ○ Vector databases ○ LLM APIs ○ Agentic AI (multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, orchestration) ● Solid understanding of API design and backend integrations. ● Ability to reason about trade-offs in performance, cost, and reliability. Nice-to-Have Skills ● Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for GenAI. ● Exposure to cloud-native deployments. ● Experience mentoring junior engineers.
